scope: Render the GTK2 scrollbar fixture in a private Xvfb using the user's explicit active GTK2 RC list, then compare both orientations with native SR10.4 cells.

capture.environment: Private Xvfb, GTK_MODULES empty, GDK_BACKEND=x11, GTK2_RC_FILES explicitly set to the active user's RC list.

candidate_comparison.method: RGB compare of the same 640x330 fixture region

body_cross_axis_profiles.adaptation: Four internal cross-section pixels are face-colored (offsets 2-3 and 11-12); 15 px thickness and the outer two-pixel dark/light edges remain.

changes: Saved the exact-RC fixture crop in records/ia-tema/I167/R734/installed-gtkrc-crop.png; the Tempia source files remain intact.
No theme, palette, desktop client, or VM was changed or restarted.
result: A fresh GTK2 2.24.33 fixture loaded the explicit installed user RC list. Its whole 640x330 raster is identical to the R731 candidate; all four normal arrow cells match the SR10.4 crops in RGB at 225/225 pixels each. Both long bodies render DDFFFFFFFFFFFLL while the literal VM body remains DDLLFFFFFFFDDLL. Colors resolve through the active KDE-derived palette. This validates the current installed RC rendering in an isolated fixture, not repaint or visual acceptance of an already-open personal application.
next: Keep R731 applied. I167 remains open for the user's visual assessment of an already-open GTK2 application after the native reload. If it still reads outward, capture and inspect that exact complete control before changing its profile.

coverage_estimate.basis: Existing I167 technical coverage estimate; not a visual-fidelity percentage.
